messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we've updated handbook sections on caregiver leave and promotion eligibility. Please skim the summary and complete the manager calibration survey + two short compliance modules by next Tue. Links below.
Jon (People Ops): Quick note: wording change is mostly to clarify partial return timelines and parental leave overlap with FMLA-equivalents by region.
Lina (Eng, Mgr): Do these changes affect promo windows already in-flight? We have 4 teams mid-cycle.
Maya (People Ops): Good question. Promo windows won't shift. We added an exception flow for caregivers requesting adjustment to review timelines; submit via the request form and we'll flag for calibration panel.
Diego (Recruiting): For roles that require relocation, does caregiver leave language change offer letters?
Jon (People Ops): Offer templates updated yesterday. Recruiting, please pull the new template v3 when drafting relocation offers.
hr-bot: Handbook summary (short): https://intranet.redwood.ai/handbook/handbook-cg-leave-update.pdf
hr-bot: Manager calibration survey: https://forms.redwood.ai/surveys/manager-calibration-1777 (5 q, ~3min)
hr-bot: Compliance modules: Unconscious Bias (10min): https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/unconscious-bias; Data Privacy Refresher (6min): https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/data-privacy-refresher
Lina (Eng, Mgr): Thanks. Will managers need to attend a live calibration?
Meredith (People Ops): We'll host two 30-min optional drop-in calibrations next Wed/Thu. Attendance not required if you complete the survey and review notes, but encouraged for calibration decisions. Calendar invites coming.
Diego (Recruiting): Noted on offer templates. Also updating the recruiter checklist to include caregiver policy talking points. Will share link shortly.
Lina (Eng, Mgr): Survey done. Completed bias module. The privacy refresher prompted a short token warning message for EU users, FYI.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks 44d Omar? (cc @Jon) - can we get localization notes for UK/EU in the handbook PDF?
Jon (People Ops): On it. I'll add an appendix for UK/EU and a short FAQ for managers. ETA EOD.
hr-bot: Completion recorded: Lina (Eng, Mgr) - survey + bias module.
Meredith (People Ops): For tracking: we'll publish roster with completion flags to managers' dashboard Friday. If your team shows missing items, we'll email reminders.
Diego (Recruiting): Shared recruiter checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/hr/recruiter-checklist-caregiver-update.md
Lina (Eng, Mgr): Signed up for drop-in Wed 11:30.
Maya (People Ops): Appreciate the quick turn. If folks want a contractor-specific summary or an accommodation template, DM me and we'll produce one. Thanks all.
Jon (People Ops): Reminder: deadline for survey + both modules = next Tue EOD. Managers, please follow up with direct reports who need help completing them.
